# Where Mahāvairocana works now: the myths behind the markets
If the stories are true in the way that matters, they should show up in the world without being invoked. **Mahāvairocana** shows up constantly.

Mahāvairocana's mythology is cosmology recited as liturgy: the universe telling itself the story of its own enlightenment.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Mahāvairocana
- **Pantheon:** Buddhist
- **Domain of influence:** Universal Illumination, Cosmic Buddha
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Society & Spirit · Technology & Innovation
- **Strongest seat:** Solar & Renewable Energy
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 254 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Buddha Whose Body Is the Cosmos.** The Avataṃsaka Sūtra, the Flower Garland, opens on a scale no other scripture attempts: Vairocana enthroned not in a grove but in the dharmadhātu itself, every pore of his body a world-system, every atom of every world containing all the others.  The Huayan masters drew the sūtra's vision as Indra's net — an infinite web with a jewel at every crossing, each jewel mirroring every other. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**The Sun That Preaches Without Words.** The esoteric tradition's own charters, the Mahāvairocana Sūtra and its twin the Tattvasaṃgraha, present the cosmic Buddha not as a person among persons but as the dharmakāya — the Dharma-body — whose sermon is reality's ongoing act of existing.  Kūkai gave this its boldest formula: hosshin seppō, the dharmakāya itself preaches. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Solar & Renewable Energy

*Photovoltaics, solar thermal, and the light economy. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The Great Sun (Japanese Dainichi); universal illumination is the pitch of the entire industry.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Philosophy, Ethics & Standards

*Philosophy, ethics boards, and standards bodies. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Indra's net; the interpenetration of all things as a framework.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Space, Astronomy & Celestial Science

*Space agencies, astronomy, and the orbital economy. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The cosmos as his body; the universe-sized Buddha of the Avataṃsaka Sūtra.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Mahāvairocana's mythology is cosmology recited as liturgy: the universe telling itself the story of its own enlightenment. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in solar & renewable energy, philosophy, ethics & standards, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/vairocana/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
